etsy.title: Mental Load Planner Printable, Household Task List for Couples, Fair Chore Chart, Invisible Labor Worksheet, Family Reset PDF
etsy.description:
Tired of being the one who remembers everything? 💗

The mental load is the noticing, remembering and planning that keeps a family running. This planner puts it on paper, so it can finally be shared.

WHAT'S INSIDE (9 pages)
• How to use the planner
• Task inventory in 3 areas (kids, home, family life): who notices, who plans, who does it
• My invisible list
• The calm conversation: words you can use + what we agreed
• 7-day reset plan
• Weekly family check-in

Companion to the book "Who Takes Care of Mom?" (Gentle Life Guides), but works on its own.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
